# embed-core

> Static token-table embedding, ternary readouts and curriculum regression gates.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/embed-core && cd embed-core && python3 -B checks/curriculum.py` (expect: PASS).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 + Free Trial (code); CC BY 4.0 (documents).
